answer_1.quote: Open domain question answering is a knowledge-intensive task that involves generating an answer as an output a given a question q as an input.

answer_2.quote: We mark a prediction as correct if any sub-string of the prediction is an exact match of any of the gold answers.

answer_4.quote: The remainder of the questions (743/14, 837) were rewritten by our three internal annotators. We divided the datasets into three overlapping sections and consulted with at least two annotators to obtain human-written questions.
answer_4.guideline: We use an annotation framework MEGAnno for this annotation due to its flexible labeling computational notebooks.
